checks.result: The clean exact implementation commit passed all 14 mandatory foundation commands and all 109 foundation tests, including repository, runtime, architecture, campaign protocol, generated views, fixture, benchmark, build-manifest, ADR, CI, quality, packaging, and backlog gates.

Eight focused tests passed for deterministic clean output, dirty and rename labeling, component regeneration, mirror/component drift, noncanonical component and lock inputs, exact schema inventory, and output confinement.

The exact clean commit generated build identity 0.1.0+g23717be and a manifest binding full commit provenance, all three dependency locks, every governed schema identity/hash, the stable model-manifest set, and compatible desktop/Core API/worker component contracts.
The authoritative ledger validated with 20 capabilities, 117 slices, 356 tasks, and 12 release gates.

evidence: packaging/product-version.json is the sole product-version authority; package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, and the three generated component contracts must exactly mirror version 0.1.0.

The desktop, Core API sidecar, and worker sidecar contracts all report compatibility line 0.1 and are regenerated only to canonical nonredirected destinations by the explicit --write-components operation.

The deterministic build manifest records full Git commit and commit time, clean/dirty state and dirty paths, SHA-256 identities for Cargo/pnpm/uv locks, every repository schema with stable $id, and the installed model-manifest set.
The clean exact build has identity 0.1.0+g23717be. Dirty builds add .dirty and record tracked, untracked, rename, and copy paths without wall-clock input.
Eight focused tests cover deterministic expected output and material failures for version drift, component drift, ungoverned inputs, schema-inventory drift, redirected output, and Git rename parsing.
The complete clean foundation profile passed 14 commands and 109 tests with build-manifest validation mandatory.

Strict Draft 2020-12 schemas govern product, component, and emitted build manifests; generated manifests and build input identities reject undeclared fields and noncanonical component/lock destinations.

CHANGELOG.md establishes Unreleased and dated product-version sections. Automation, component, tool, test, and repository documentation explains authority, regeneration, provenance, compatibility, and dirty-build behavior.
quality-scope.json governs the generator and tests, and verification-profiles.json makes build-manifest generation a mandatory foundation gate. No migration or user-experience contract is affected.

reviewerDisposition.note: Independent review must adversarially test version-authority and generated-component drift, canonical input/path confinement, deterministic hashes and set identifiers, Git dirty/rename/copy parsing, schema completeness and uniqueness, output confinement, and changelog/documentation accuracy.
